context_for_next_testing_agent: Lead Magnet Minion fully tested. All CRUD, content generation (LLM), PDF generation, publish flow, version history, and public download working. Fixed critical PDF generation bug where FPDF multi_cell was not resetting x-position after each call, causing 'Not enough horizontal space' error. Also added comprehensive Unicode sanitization for PDF content. Known data state: 5+ lead magnets exist, some published with PDFs.

bugs_fixed.issue: PDF generation failing with 'Not enough horizontal space to render a single character'
bugs_fixed.root_cause: FPDF multi_cell() does not reset x-position to left margin after rendering. Subsequent multi_cell calls start at the right edge of the page.
bugs_fixed.fix: Added new_x='LMARGIN', new_y='NEXT' parameters to all multi_cell() calls in generate_pdf_bytes()

bugs_fixed.issue: PDF generation failing with Unicode character errors
bugs_fixed.root_cause: LLM-generated content contains Unicode characters (curly quotes, em dashes, etc.) that Helvetica font doesn't support
bugs_fixed.fix: Enhanced sanitize_text_for_pdf() function to replace all Unicode characters with ASCII equivalents

lead_magnet_crud.create: Working - returns magnet with id, public_id, status=Draft
lead_magnet_crud.list: Working - supports status and format_type filters
lead_magnet_crud.update: Working - updates fields and creates version on content change

content_generation.generate: Working - calls GPT-5.2 via Emergent LLM key, returns structured content

pdf_generation.preview: Working - returns PDF with inline disposition
pdf_generation.unicode_handling: Working - sanitizes all Unicode to ASCII

publish_flow.mark_ready: Working - validates title, landing snippet, has_pdf
